caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress with long sleeves, a high neckline, and a fitted waist tied with a matching fabric belt. The dress is decorated with vertical stripes featuring detailed floral and ornamental patterns in colors including blue, red, yellow, green, and beige. The main figure of the dress is rendered in color, while the head and neck are only partially sketched and left unfinished. To the right, there is a smaller, outline-only sketch showing the back view of the same dress, without any color or intricate pattern, and preserving the same silhouette with details of seam lines and gathered fabric at the waist. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Dress
